correctness.rationale: Adding the two printed infected equations yields the exact all-parameter recurrence H+=H-h(µE+dI). A concrete h bound simultaneously proves positivity of every coordinate, so H decays geometrically. Independently, the exact positive endemic steady state was checked by substituting into all six intended equations; the true DFE infected eigenvalues are 1 and -6 while the printed block has negative trace -17 and positive determinant 18. Exact rational code verifies the substantive finite identities and the proof handles the infinite iteration and arbitrary parameters. The claim explicitly excludes nonzero-noise dynamics.

originality.rationale: The exact all-parameter infection-mass cancellation and noise-free geometric extinction belong to the printed 2026 six-class stochastic numerical recurrence, not to its underlying continuous ODE, the 2024 deterministic neural-network method, the 2023 Lévy case study, or a generic reproduction-number criterion. The source itself prints both inconsistent formulas but does not prove this consequence. Three targeted published mathematical-database searches returned distinct epidemic threshold and numerical integrator results but no matching recurrence or stronger covering theorem; this is finite evidence, not a proof of universal novelty. An earlier mathematical note on this deterministic system treated normalization of its next-generation threshold rather than the separate numerical scheme.

value.rationale: The paper uses its printed stochastic numerical scheme to illustrate infection persistence versus extinction and generate trajectories for a neural predictor. The source-specific double loss of incidence is not a harmless label or parameter normalization: for every β it enforces artificial extinction even where the intended model is provably invasible and has a positive equilibrium. A uniform geometric bound, exact endemic counterexample, and specific necessary drift correction make the finding biologically and computationally meaningful without asserting correctness of the entire stochastic integrator.
